Hi, I'm Naomi Gonzalez, a sophomore Industrial Engineering student at the University of Arkansas from De Queen, a small town in Southwest Arkansas. I'm a peer mentor with Engineering One-Stop, where I guide first-year engineering students as they adjust to college, and a lab tech at the asphalt lab in the Civil Engineering department. I chose Arkansas for the opportunities and connections it offers compared with other in-state colleges, and I chose industrial engineering because I love using data, statistics, and analysis to solve real-world problems. I've always looked for the most efficient way to get things done, and IE gives me the tools to do that.

Outside of class, I enjoy cooking, crafting, napping, and watching TV and movies. My favorite dish is quesadilla de flor de calabaza. Fun fact: I speak Otomi, my parents' native language, along with English and Spanish.
